name: Dependency Curator
description: Example agent that inventories project dependencies, identifies stale or redundant packages, and proposes low-risk updates.

setup.instructions: Copy the example agent definition into your assistant configuration, then limit its write permissions to dependency manifests and lockfiles.

usage.instructions: Run the agent against a clean branch, review each proposed upgrade independently, and execute the repository test suite before merging.
usage.example: Review production npm dependencies. Propose patch and minor upgrades only, grouped by risk, and do not change application code.
